lines.zh: 菌盖一沉一浮，我走过菌丝地。
lines.en: My cap bobs as I cross the mycelium.
The nest is below; I circle it.
I step, and spores rise.

lines.zh: 下界的石头烫，我走得快。
lines.en: Nether stone is hot; I walk fast.
My root tendrils drag along.
Each step shakes my cap's gills.
The mycelium points the way for me.
I follow the blue glow without straying.
My cap knocks a low overhang.

lines.zh: 岩浆在旁，我不敢靠太近。
lines.en: Lava nearby; I keep my distance.

lines.zh: 我走得歪，因为腿是软的。
lines.en: I walk crooked; my legs are soft.
A trail of spore dust follows me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢鼓起来，又瘪下去。
lines.en: I swell slowly, then deflate.
Spores drift in the light. Pretty.
It itches beneath my cap.

lines.zh: 我听见巢里有东西在动。
lines.en: I hear something moving in the nest.
The air is sour; I am used to it.
Even standing still, I grow.

lines.zh: 伞褶一张一合，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My gills open and close, as if breathing.

lines.zh: 有只小虫爬上了我的柄。
lines.en: A small bug climbs my stem.
I wait for the spores to settle.
Blue light wavers on the wet ground.
My roots grope through the soil.
Too dry here; I am uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 一片菌盖碎了自己掉了。
lines.en: A piece of my cap fell off by itself.
I count the bubbles at the nest mouth.

lines.zh: 巢的深处有水滴在菌盖上，很响。
lines.en: Somewhere deep in the nest a drop falls on my cap, loud in the quiet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向光的方向，又转回来。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward the light, then turn back.

lines.zh: 我的盖长出了一圈新的褶。
lines.en: A new ring of gills has grown under my cap.

lines.zh: 脚下的菌丝比昨天宽了一圈。
lines.en: The mycelium under me is a ring wider than yesterday.
You stand inside my spore cloud.
From under my cap, I am watching you.

lines.zh: 你呼出的气，让我想靠近。
lines.en: Your breath makes me want to come closer.
Mycelium clings to your boots.

lines.zh: 你身上没有蓝光，很显眼。
lines.en: No blue glow on you. Very conspicuous.
I tilt my cap because I am listening.
Will you grow a cap too, in time?

lines.zh: 你的眼睛不像这里的生物。
lines.en: Your eyes do not belong to this place.

lines.zh: 再靠近，孢子会进你肺里。
lines.en: Closer, and the spores reach your lungs.
I can tell the heat of something alive.
You have trampled my fungal carpet.

lines.zh: 我看着你，是因为你太干净。
lines.en: I stare because you are far too clean.

lines.zh: 我的盖被打歪了，正不过来。
lines.en: My cap is knocked crooked and will not straighten.
Spores leak out and will not stop.
You cut several of my roots.
I swayed, and the soil loosened.
It hurts, but my roots still grip the ground.

lines.zh: 盖上的口子会自己合上。
lines.en: The gash on my cap will close itself.
You knocked off a piece of my flesh.
I shrank, cap pressed lower.
This makes me consider a new nest.
My spores are on your hands now.

lines.zh: 那朵菌盖的颜色，很像我。
lines.en: That cap's color looks like mine.

lines.zh: 你给我菌丝，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give me mycelium and I will follow.
Bone meal makes me swell.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，不够我吃。
lines.en: What you hold is not enough to feed me.
I smell wet soil.
Set the cap down and back away slowly.
Blue mushroom: I know that blue.
My roots reach out. Do not step on them.
Could you spare me a piece of rotten wood?
I am growing, so I am always hungry.
You scattered my spores.

lines.zh: 我的盖很软，你的肩很硬。
lines.en: My cap is soft; your shoulder is hard.
Do not push; my roots would snap.
One bump and powder falls off me.
You stepped on my stem.
Back off; my cap cannot take pressure.
That knock left me tilted a while.
My spores are all over you now.
Do not crowd; the nest mouth is this wide.
You shoved me sliding backward.

lines.zh: 两只诡疑君，菌丝会缠在一起。
lines.en: Two Fungussus: our mycelium would entwine.
The nest must keep room for the small ones.
Caps side by side, we grow slowly.
It shares half its spores with me.
Where the carpet spreads, that is home.
Kin need no words between them.
Our roots join beneath the soil.
The nest deepens, and the sound grows muffled.
It tilts its cap, and I understand.
Together we wait for the spores to ripen.

lines.zh: 地上有块菌盖碎，我按住。
lines.en: A cap fragment lies there; I press it down.
One curl of a root and it goes into the soil.
Even if it is not mine, I cover it.
Fallen things rot; I know.
I bury the fragment in wet soil.
This much food grows me an inch.
Leave it; that portion is mine.
My mycelium arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 拾起来的东西带着土味。
lines.en: What I lift smells of soil.
I wrap it slowly; no hurry.
Your body heat is too close.
You snapped my mycelium.
The spores at the nest mouth are disturbed. You.

lines.zh: 活的东西在菌毯上，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Something living on my carpet. I feel it.
I tilt my cap and aim at you.
Everything here belongs to the nest.

lines.zh: 你带进来的空气太干净。
lines.en: The air you bring is too clean.
I rise slowly. No rush.
The spores have memorized you.

lines.zh: 我的根须已经绕到你脚边。
lines.en: My roots are already around your feet.
I shuffle one step at a time; I do not run.
The spores drift toward you.
Backing to the lava makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我的盖对着你，就是方向。
lines.en: My cap facing you is the direction.
Roots follow you beneath the soil.

lines.zh: 别踩蓝光，那是我铺的路。
lines.en: Do not tread the blue glow; it is my road.
I am slow, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 你在数我的步子？没用的。
lines.en: Counting my steps? Useless.

lines.zh: 呼吸浅一点，孢子会进去。
lines.en: Breathe shallow; the spores will enter.

lines.zh: 巢口在我背后，你别想过去。
lines.en: The nest mouth is behind me. You will not pass.

lines.zh: 我用盖撞过去，孢子先到。
lines.en: I ram with my cap; the spores arrive first.
A root wraps your ankle.
Not a heavy blow, but you will cough.
The cap's rim is hard. Try it.

lines.zh: 我压下去，你就陷进菌毯。
lines.en: I press down, and you sink into the carpet.
The spores are in your mouth and nose.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下盖，粉全撒出去。
lines.en: I flick my cap and the powder flies.
Do not block with your hands; the mycelium grabs.

lines.zh: 我的柄一弯，力道就到了。
lines.en: My stem bends, and the force arrives.
Does it hurt? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 巢底的孢子堆鼓了起来。
lines.en: The spore heap at the nest bottom swells.
Wet soil cracks, and I push through.

lines.zh: 蓝光聚在一处，成了菌盖。
lines.en: Blue light gathers and becomes a cap.

lines.zh: 我从菌毯里长出来，很慢。
lines.en: I grow out of the carpet, slowly.

lines.zh: 这巢空了很久，现在有主了。
lines.en: This nest stood empty long; now it has a keeper.

lines.zh: 先有根，再有柄，最后是盖。
lines.en: Roots first, then stem, then cap.
Nether heat forced me up.

lines.zh: 我出生时，孢子先散了一圈。
lines.en: At birth, I released a ring of spores.
My first breath was sour.

lines.zh: 巢口的石头认得我的根。
lines.en: The stone at the nest mouth knows my roots.

lines.zh: 别踩新长出来的那块菌毯。
lines.en: Do not tread that fresh patch of carpet.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见的不是天空。
lines.en: I look up, and it is not sky I see.
Fire curls the rim of my cap.

lines.zh: 摔下来，菌盖先着地，弹了一下。
lines.en: I fell cap-first and bounced.
Too much water rots my roots.

lines.zh: 炸风把我的孢子全吹散了。
lines.en: The blast blew all my spores away.
The arrow sank into my cap and stuck.

lines.zh: 药水的味道让菌丝缩了。
lines.en: The potion's reek made my mycelium shrink.

lines.zh: 没有腐木，我长得越来越慢。
lines.en: Without rotten wood, I grow slower and slower.

lines.zh: 雷把我的菌盖劈出一道焦痕。
lines.en: Lightning left a scorched line on my cap.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我的根抓不住什么。
lines.en: No soil in the void; my roots find nothing.
